zh_CN.web.exportTitle: 绘图模板 ➡ 材质贴图
zh_CN.web.helpExport:
1. 把 128×80 的绘制模板拖进来，或点「来个 Demo」。
2. 结果自动生成，改「女性版本」「叠加玩家」或 GIF 速率 / 尺寸会重画。
3. 改表格里的盔甲 ID 会重命名文件，1.4 页签可下载材质包。
4. 拖动区右上角的图标：参考线、下载、最近导出、清空。
zh_CN.web.helpSheets:
1. 从头 / 身体 / 腿三格放入对应贴图，或用「上传」一次选 1~3 张。
2. 名称看不出部位时按形状匹配；头与腿同形状，文件更大的算腿部。
3. 每格右上角 × 清空该格；头部与腿部的 ⇅ 可以互换。
4. 三张齐了右侧播放器自动播放；女版与叠加玩家只改这个预览。
5. 播放器下方链接给出当前预览的 PNG；「下载材质包」导出游戏可直接读取的 zip。

en.web.subtitle: Terraria armor sheets, in the browser
en.web.drop:
Drop or upload a drawing template
PNG and WebP only
en.web.demoTooltip: Load the bundled drawing template as a sample
en.web.demoSheetsTooltip: Load the bundled sheets as a sample
en.web.helpExport:
1. Drop a 128x80 drawing template in, or click Demo.
2. Results are drawn at once; the switches and the GIF speed / size redraw them.
3. Editing an armor ID renames the files; the 1.4 tab downloads the pack.
4. The icons in the drop area: guide, download, history, clear.
en.web.helpSheets:
1. Drop the head / body / legs sheets in, or pick 1-3 at once with Upload.
2. Names that say nothing fall back to the shape; head and legs look alike, the bigger file is the legs.
3. The x in a corner clears that slot; the arrows on head and legs swap them.
4. With all three in, the player on the right runs on its own; the female and player switches only change that preview.
5. The link under the player hands out the PNG of what is shown; the pack button exports a ready-to-use zip.
